description: Criterion 30 (M6, T-160): links the settings schema's if/then and the Java Link both accept, and links both refuse at the missing field. Read by check/manifest.test.mjs and LinkFieldsTest.

accepted.why: a tcp-client in link needs only the peer
a link of the default mode and direction needs only the peer
a tcp-client out link needs only the peer
an out link may name its STANAG 4607 edition (M9.1)
a udp in link needs only the listen port
a udp link of the default direction needs only the listen port
a udp out link needs only the peer
a tcp-server in link needs only the listen port
a tcp-server out link needs only the listen port
a hidden peer keeps its value
a hidden listen address keeps its value

refused.why: the owner's RC1 case: a udp in link with a peer but no listen port
a udp link of the default direction without a listen port
a tcp-server in link without a listen port
a tcp-server out link without a listen port
a tcp-client link without its host
a link of the default mode without its host
a tcp-client link without its port
a udp out link without its host
a udp out link without its port
